cron.description: 5-field cron in Asia/Seoul local time. Leave out when in_minutes is given

in_minutes.description: one run this many minutes from now

once.description: true when it runs only one time at the cron moment

notify.description: always: told at every run. on_change: only when something changed since the last run

prompt.description: self-contained instruction executed at each run; names exactly as the user wrote them

skill.description: an agent skill or one of my skills (facts) that does exactly this job

process.description: a process id (facts) started at each run

params.description: inputs for the skill, or the process's first-step fields
